title: Webデザイン
subtitle: Web Design
keywords: Information design 2.Web Design 3.HTML/CSS 4.Intellectual property rights 5.Regional contribution
educationalGoal: In this Web design course, students will learn the concepts behind website construction, including information structure and effective navigation, as part of efforts to impart the knowledge necessary for designing easy-to-read and easy-to-use Web pages. In addition, the characteristics of multimedia material, the use of HTML and CSS, as well as techniques for making Web pages using a laptop computer, will be covered.
advice: Students are expected to acquire the knowledge and skills of webpage production based on the basic concepts of information design, understand the outline of the World Wide Web (WWW), and master fundamental website creation procedures such as planning, design, production, operation and management through practical training. To accomplish this, students will gain an understanding of the basic grammar of HTML and practice the use of CSS as a basic writing method for expressing Web pages. Other course contents will include the effective presentation of information in an easy-to-read manner, making the Web page easy to read, and discussing matters to be considered in order to effectively communicate through Web pages.
requiredKnowledge: Students are expected to be familiar with basic personal computer operations.

activityGoals.body: Be able to set up your own laptop PC and browse the World Wide Web.
Be able to write Web pages using text and multimedia in HTML by using a text editor.
Be able to upload the created HTML file to a Web server.
Be able to create a webpage layout using CSS.
Be able to create while taking into consideration effective information expression, information arrangement.
Be able to understand the concepts of personal information, security, copyright regulations, and netiquette.
